lineage: Began as the Nitrogen malvertising loader (2023) used by affiliates to deploy BlackCat/ALPHV; operating its own double-extortion ransomware since late 2024, reportedly built from leaked Conti builder components
summary: Nitrogen started as a malvertising loader: search ads lead IT staff to fake download sites for Advanced IP Scanner, WinSCP, PuTTY or AnyDesk, whose ZIP installers sideload a malicious python3xx.dll. This leads to Sliver and Cobalt Strike, PowerView/SharpHound discovery, LSASS dumping, pass-the-hash and Impacket movement, and Restic exfiltration. Ransomware is pushed with PsExec after a Safe Mode with Networking reboot and mass event-log clearing. 2025 reporting adds a truesight.sys BYOVD EDR killer, .NBA-encrypted files, and an ESXi locker whose key-handling flaw makes decryption impossible.
uniqueTraits: Malvertising of trojanized IT-admin tools (Advanced IP Scanner, WinSCP, PuTTY, AnyDesk) with a legitimate renamed python.exe side-loading python311/312.dll
In-memory Python loaders (slv.py, wo14.py) for Sliver and Cobalt Strike
Restic backup tool used to exfiltrate file-server shares to a REST server
Safe Mode with Networking reboot plus RunOnce/auto-logon to launch the encryptor, with hundreds of wevtutil cl runs
truesight.sys BYOVD EDR killer (2025); ESXi locker key-corruption bug means paying does not get files back (2026)

chain.procedure: Bing/Google search ads redirect admins to fake or compromised WordPress sites offering trojanized Advanced IP Scanner, WinSCP, PuTTY or AnyDesk downloads (e.g. Version.zip, WinSCP-6.3.6-Setup.zip).
chain.noAtomicReason: The local catalogue has no drive-by/malvertising atomic (T1189); validate with web-proxy and DNS detections for newly registered look-alike software download domains.

chain.procedure: The user extracts the ZIP and runs setup.exe (a renamed legitimate python.exe) believing it is the installer.

atomics.note: User runs a downloaded potentially unwanted application (local ART T1204.002 #8)

chain.procedure: setup.exe sideloads the malicious python311.dll / python312.dll (NitrogenLoader, export-mirrored), which runs Python loaders (slv.py, wo14.py, Py-Fuscate obfuscated) in memory while the real installer runs in the foreground.

atomics.note: DLL side-loading through a legitimate signed binary (Notepad++ GUP.exe) (local ART T1574.001 #4)

chain.procedure: Sliver over 8443 and Cobalt Strike over HTTPS 443 with a malleable profile imitating Amazon traffic (XOR-encoded config, watermark shared with Black Basta).

atomics.note: Scripted HTTP C2 requests with unusual user agents; approximates beacon HTTP telemetry, not the malleable profile (local ART T1071.001 #1)

chain.procedure: SYSTEM tasks named like 'OneDrive Security Task-S-1-5-21-…' and 'UpdateEdge' run UpdateEdge.bat on start-up, every 720 minutes and on idle.

Scheduled task running a script at startup (local ART T1053.005 #1)

chain.procedure: Sliver DLL injected via the pythonmemorymodule technique; a cmd.exe process opens winlogon.exe with VM_WRITE access and injects into it.
